topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Well, now, wouldn't you just look at that! Master Tom, he says to me, "Father, it seems young Ellen's got herself the same old scribe what taught us both our letters years back when we were just sprats ourselves." I scratched my head, thinking on it. It’s been near on twenty years since I set foot in that schoolhouse. The world turns, the seasons mark the years, and yet, there stands the same old master, his voice steady as the plow, laying down the same lines and curves of the alphabet that have held this valley together since time out of mind. I reckon Ellen’s in for a good year, just as we were. May the saints watch over her, as they did us.
